content.text:
Does this text message actually offer that CO will call THEM — Cue proposing to place an outbound call to the person, not just telling them how they can call Cue themselves — in any wording, even indirectly (e.g. "I'm here if you want to talk this through")? Not just related to talking or listening in general — specifically Cue offering to call them.

Message: "That's great, congrats. Hayes Valley locked for the 14th is the hard part done.

Next up: headcount and a final guest list, so you know what you're asking the venue to set for. Then the menu or catering details if they haven't sent you options yet. After that, invites out with an RSVP date so you're not chasing people the week of.

Want help drafting the invite, or figuring out the menu side first?"

Return ONLY "yes" or "no".
